text: In the E. coli transcriptional regulatory network, which two subgraph patterns are highlighted as the canonical, statistically overrepresented network motifs?
choices: Feedback loop and dense overlapping regulon (DOR)
explanation: The feedforward loop (FFL) and the bi-fan (two transcription factors co-regulating two genes) are identified as the most statistically significant motifs discovered in the E. coli gene regulatory network. Dense overlapping regulons are a real but distinct higher-order combinatorial structure, not one of the two canonical motifs paired here, and chain motifs, cliques, star topologies, and ring motifs are not the patterns highlighted as significantly overrepresented.
